 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 🌸 Rose Quartz Wishlist Vase (Rose Quartz + Geode) 🌸

Where love meets intention—introducing the Rose Quartz Wishlist Vase, beautifully crafted and crowned with a genuine Rose Quartz Geode. This vase is more than décor; it’s a sacred vessel to hold your heart’s deepest wishes and dreams.

Rose Quartz, the Crystal of Love & Harmony, opens the heart to compassion, self-healing, and emotional balance. It invites tenderness into your space, nurturing relationships and amplifying inner peace.

The Rose Quartz Geode topper enhances its energy, radiating unconditional love and amplifying every intention you place within.

Together, they create a powerful wish-holder—aligning your desires with love, healing, and universal harmony.

Simply write your wishes, fold them, and place them inside the vase—turning each thought into a heart-centered intention. Perfect as spiritual décor, meditation support, or a meaningful gift, the Rose Quartz Chips Wishlist Vase is a gentle reminder that your dreams deserve to be held with love. 🌸✨

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is the purpose of this product?

This product is designed to help you focus on love, intentions, and emotional well-being while enhancing your space with positive energy.

Q2. What does Rose Quartz represent?

Rose Quartz is associated with love, compassion, emotional healing, and harmony in relationships.

Q3. How do I use this “wish in the bottle”?

Place it in a space where you can see it daily and use it as a reminder of your intentions related to love and positivity.

Q4. Is the crystal inside natural?

Yes, the Rose Quartz used is natural, so slight variations in color and texture may occur.

Q5. Where should I place it for best results?

It works best on your bedside, personal desk, or any space connected to relaxation and emotional comfort.

Q6. Does it require any maintenance?

No special maintenance is required. Simply keep it clean and place it in a meaningful spot.

Q7. Can it be used for gifting?

Yes, it makes a thoughtful gift symbolizing love, care, and emotional connection.
